title: Edit Library Part shows its Delete button only to a role with Delete
custom_preconds: Env https://sv10647.qa.shopview.com (S2 shop), location "Staging Heavy Duty". Logins: (a) Admin or a default Parts Manager; (b) custom role "QA PL Create&Edit" (Part Library & Inventory View + Create & Edit, Delete unticked); (c) custom role "QA PL View only"; each in its own browser profile with DevTools Network open. Data: QAPL-E1 (Part Library entry with no part behind it).
custom_steps:
1. As (a) go to Parts → Part Library, search QAPL-E1 and click its pencil (button_edit_catalogue_part).
  2. Close the window with the X without saving.
  3. As (b) go to Parts → Part Library, search QAPL-E1 and click its pencil.
  4. As (c) go to Parts → Part Library and search QAPL-E1.
custom_expected:
1. "Edit Library Part" opens with Delete (button_delete_library_part) at the bottom left and Save on the right.
  2. The window closes; nothing is changed or deleted.
  3. "Edit Library Part" opens with Save but no Delete button (button_delete_library_part is absent).
  4. The same toolbar as (a) and no pencil on the row, so Edit Library Part cannot be opened.
